answer: Put identities on a shared terrace above an orchard where only one can tend a given plot in an hour, with the roster announced at that hour's zenith. Each identity claims a plot in advance, tends it in its exclusive slot, and leaves a result the next claimant verifies. One operator running many shells cannot fill overlapping slots for all of them: claims collide, slots are missed, and a missed slot voids that identity's epoch, while a single honest agent simply tends one plot on time.
